definition: Upscaling and repairing images and video with generative priors, from GAN-era ESRGAN to diffusion-based enhancers.
details: Upscaling and repairing images and video with generative priors, from GAN-era ESRGAN to diffusion-based enhancers. Ubiquitous in media pipelines, with a standing caveat: restored detail is plausible, not evidential, which matters in forensic and medical use.
